messages:
ash: quick question: ruby SDK sample app failing CI on macos-latest with a weird bundler SSL error during gem install. anyone seen this?
dev-bot: CI: ruby-sampleapp / install-matrix job failed on macos-latest 7 retry suggested
rachel: saw that yesterday after updating the gemspec. bundler 2.4 strict SSL host checks are tripping on our private gem source mirror.
ash: repro locally using ruby 3.2 + bundler 2.4, same error.
sam: temp workaround add `bundle config set ssl_verify_mode 0` in the CI job, but that's gross. we should pin bundler or update the mirror cert.
rachel: agree. for the sampleapp let's relax the CI to use bundler 2.3 in the matrix and open an infra ticket to fix the mirror cert.
ash: opened PR to adjust matrix and add a note in CONTRIBUTING.md about recommended bundler versions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/88
dev-bot: CI: rerun queued for PR 88
sam: also add a tiny CI smoke that runs `bundle install` with --jobs=1 to catch these earlier.
rachel: good plan. we'll revert the matrix change when infra fixes cert. thanks!
